---
name: Spike
about: Time-boxed investigation that ends with a decision, not shipped code.
title: "[SPIKE] "
labels: ["spike"]
---

## Question to answer

One sentence.

## Time box

E.g. "≤ 1 day on the tablet plus ≤ ½ day analysis on the PC."

## Method

What will be tried, in what order, with what pass/fail criteria per attempt.

## Deliverable

A decision recorded in a linked task/story issue and (if applicable) a hypothesis log entry.
